text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Libyan Industry and Mining Minister Muftah al-Khuza heads delegation of businessmen interested mainly in textile and car sectors.
- French Lyonnaise des Eaux which will take over Casablanca water and electricity distribution assesses situation at news conference.
- Survey of economic thinktank Centre Marocain de Conjoncture says prospects promising this year.
- Businessmen and press question deal to be concluded with Lyonnaise des Eaux and Casablanca at a time when its management is under review in France.
- Foreign investments shrank 6.4 percent in 1996 to 3.7 billion ($597.8 million) because of high competitiveness.
- Marrakesh to host first international seminar on maternal mortality on March 10-14.
